final: WITH rating_stats AS (SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS avg_length, AVG(rental_rate) AS avg_rental_rate, AVG(rental_duration) AS avg_rental_duration, AVG(rental_rate) / AVG(rental_duration) AS per_day_price FROM film GROUP BY rating), mean_per_day_price AS (SELECT AVG(per_day_price) AS mean_price FROM rating_stats), filtered_ratings AS (SELECT rs.rating, rs.avg_length, rs.per_day_price, mpdp.mean_price FROM rating_stats rs CROSS JOIN mean_per_day_price mpdp WHERE rs.per_day_price > mpdp.mean_price) SELECT AVG(avg_length) AS avg_of_avg_lengths, AVG(per_day_price) AS avg_of_per_day_prices, AVG(per_day_price - mean_price) AS avg_excess FROM filtered_ratings
